display_name: LoRa 与 WiSig 共用 Packet U-Net 先验和 DURA 求解的源域对照
description: 同一两步 MAP 和修正剂量限制，分别在 LoRa 与 WiSig 上比较直通、原生 DURA、Packet U-Net、组合。单种子，先做固定源 V 配对否证。
authorization: 当前用户要求在 LoRa 与 WiSig 验证结合 Packet U-Net 和 DURA。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI PyTorch CUDA FP32, separate CPU scorer

data.dataset: IEEE DataPort multi-receiver LoRa and WiSig/ManySig Main split
data.version: lora_full_packets_v1; WiSig registered R17/WiSig Main source cache
data.representation: LoRa complex 8192 at 1 MS/s -> original W24. WiSig complex 256 -> original Tri-SIG-TIME SSL.
data.contract_ref: LoRa parent frozen source contract.json; WiSig 20261019-phase1-reception-restoration-selfsup-manysig-m6-r02/cache/complete.json
data.physical_ids_ref: LoRa established 300 Full source V panel; WiSig 1800 existing validation_full/physical_ids.npy IDs
data.label_map_ref: Original frozen E104 (10) and WiSig Main seed 2026092701 (6); independent scorer only.
data.validation_ref: Reuse registered validates-once source handles and fixed physical panels.
data.leo_config_ref: In both datasets, existing source Full practical six and clean; WiSig uses cache, LoRa exact source_receive replay.

permissions.claim_scope: Shared architecture with dataset-specific checkpoints. WiSig new fit sees only TX-hidden source U_s with generic noise and echo. No F weights or outputs in its objective. No target access.

checkpoint.initialization: LoRa exact same-contract frozen Packet U-Net and native R02/R07; WiSig Packet U-Net scratch + original R69 inference context.

sources.role: same-contract LoRa prior and frozen E104 configuration
same-contract LoRa R02/R07 action estimate and frozen archive R17 comparator
WiSig archived R69 loader, original Main source and frozen classifier binding

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Pinned historical releases, runtime contracts, strict weight loads and fixed-panel comparator check.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Each dataset uses only weights with its own existing source contract. New WiSig fit from scratch.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Each dataset's hybrid must strictly improve both single-module comparators and direct on six-scene total, with low urban and clean at least as high as every control. First run is source-only; formal expansion requires both dataset source gates.

execution.launch_owner: Current Codex chat, LoRa-WiSig Packet-DURA comparison
execution.gpu_policy: LoRa only in r03. Reuse running WiSig r02. Same GPU selection limits.
execution.stop_rule: Stop on illegal or mismatched data/weights, failed no-query smoke, finite check, missing prediction or systemic launch failure. Preserve all partial artifacts, no target access.

expected_artifacts: WiSig same matrices and training proof in r02

rows.method: Paired matrix: direct, original DURA, Packet U-Net, hybrid
rows.seed_notes: Historical weights retain parent seeds (LoRa G 2026113011 and DURA 2026113009/10/11, WiSig R69 2026092701). Null values mean no new model/draw, fixed registered panel or no support.

rows.method: Paired matrix: direct, original DURA, Packet U-Net, hybrid
rows.seed_notes: Historical weights retain parent seeds (LoRa G 2026113011 and DURA 2026113009/10/11, WiSig R69 2026092701). Null values mean no new model/draw, fixed registered panel or no support.
rows.budget_ref: single shared WiSig fit, 1600 steps batch 24, cosine to 3e-5

notes: Hybrid uses frozen per-packet action and variance, +0.02 normalized variance floor, 2 CG updates, cap additional edit RMS at 0.5 of the proposal edit RMS.
Fit the WiSig Packet U-Net once for both learned arms. V panels and frozen labels remain out of fit. WiSig uses eight contiguous 32-point groups; LoRa uses eight 1024-point chirps.
Both datasets have role definitions in their referenced contracts. The combined 2100 V total is just coverage; do not pool scores across datasets.
R02 fixes only historical archive import order. Both archived dependency imports passed isolated N607 probes before relaunch.

R03 corrects LoRa classifier archive shadowing only and runs LoRa only. The complete r02 WiSig prediction matrix is reused after its frozen marker; r03 scorer checks both complete before loading source truth. Seed, scientific matrix, training budget and source gate unchanged. Real two-row LoRa CPU smoke with exact readers succeeded on N607 before r03 release.
